_comment: Schema every command KB file must conform to. Top-level keys sit directly at the root of the JSON object — there is NO wrapping 'command' key. This matches kb/commands/admin/identify.json exactly; use that file as a second, concrete reference alongside this schema.
required_parameters: list of parameter name strings that MUST be present, e.g. "cns"
optional_parameters: list of parameter name strings that are optional

PARAM_NAME.type: hex | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | bool
PARAM_NAME.default: optional — fixed default value if this parameter is optional
PARAM_NAME.valid_ref: optional — table name in kb/tables/ for valid value lookup

sq._comment: Only include CDW10-CDW15 here (command-specific). CDW0-CDW9 are built automatically by 03_sq_builder.py from meta.opcode and resolved parameters — do not include them.

FIELD_NAME.value: a parameter name from 'parameters' above (e.g. "cns"), or a fixed hex string like "0x00"

sq.CDW11: 0x00000000 — use a plain hex string instead of an object for CDWs with no named fields

response.note: optional general note about the response

per_cns._comment: OPTIONAL — only used when the response structure varies by a selector field like CNS. If present, use this instead of the flat 'fields' key above. Keys are the selector's hex value, e.g. "0x01".

0x01.desc: description of this variant's response structure
